paragraphs.source_en: Hideyoshi suffered in silence; never had he imagined that the rumors would spread so quickly. paragraphs.source_en: In the third month of the fourth year of Bunroku, Hideyoshi impatiently gave Ohiroi the name Hideyori and petitioned the court to confer a rank upon him.
